neighbours.label: Weak pole with no clear trigger: best guess is a determiner after a preposition in technical measurement prose (within an individual, for a module); probes never reached 0.30.
fire: The power rating is quoted for a module rather than for a single cell.
Blood pressure can change by fifteen percent within a single day.
Efficiency is measured for a panel under standard test conditions.
The error is computed for a sample of one hundred readings.
Average yields from 1990 to 2010 rose by twelve percent.
Readings can drift by five percent within an hour of calibration.
The cost is estimated for a household of four people.
Heights varied by ten percent within a family.
quiet: The power rating is printed on the back of the module.
Blood pressure is usually measured in the morning.
Efficiency depends on the angle of the panel and the weather.
The error came from a loose cable in the lab.
Yields were good this year despite the dry spring.
Readings were taken every hour after calibration.
The cost of living keeps rising in the capital.
The family went to the beach every summer.

predictions: Expected to fail: the best probe was 0.27 and the median fire is unlikely to reach 0.20. Recorded so the pole is marked as tried.
notes: Probes (fraction of max 6.5): 'computed for a module' 0.270, 'from 1928 to 2014' 0.182, 'of anyone born after' 0.154, 'within an individual' 0.049; plain prose 0.016-0.070. Card peaks are scattered (' ', ' a', ' an', code newlines); the + pole is broad (1.1%).
